baseline.query:
with f as(select '7ce735e9-228f-4cc6-a7e3-16e1081f7618'::uuid id), counts as(
select 'auth_users' scope,count(*) n from auth.users t join f on t.id=f.id
union all select 'auth_sessions',count(*) from auth.sessions t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'refresh_tokens',count(*) from auth.refresh_tokens t join f on t.user_id=f.id::text
union all select 'identities',count(*) from auth.identities t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'student_roles',count(*) from public.user_roles t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'roles_assigned',count(*) from public.user_roles t join f on t.assigned_by=f.id
union all select 'registry',count(*) from private.internal_test_accounts t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'profiles',count(*) from public.profiles t join f on t.id=f.id
union all select 'forum_profiles',count(*) from public.forum_profile_settings t join f on t.user_id=f.id
union all select 'debate_events',count(*) from public.debate_v3_events t join f on t.owner_id=f.id::text or t.state->'members' ? f.id::text
union all select 'debate_receipts',count(*) from public.debate_v3_receipts t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e'
union all select 'debate_audit',count(*) from public.debate_v3_audit t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e'
union all select 'debate_match_versions',count(*) from public.debate_v3_match_versions t where event_id='de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e'
union all select 'debate_ballots',count(*) from public.debate_v3_ballots t join f on t.judge_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e'
union all select 'debate_votes',count(*) from public.debate_v3_votes t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e'
union all select 'debate_outbox',count(*) from public.debate_v3_outbox t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e'
union all select 'debate_uploads',count(*) from public.debate_v3_uploads t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text or t.event_id='de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e'
union all select 'debate_rate_limits',count(*) from public.debate_v3_rate_limits t join f on t.actor_id=f.id::text
union all select 'storage_owned',count(*) from storage.objects t join f on t.owner=f.id or t.owner_id=f.id::text or t.name like '%de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e%'
) select clock_timestamp() checked_at,jsonb_object_agg(scope,n) counts from counts;
baseline.ownershipQuery:
select clock_timestamp() checked_at, u.id, u.created_at, u.last_sign_in_at,
u.email='dd-study-room-student-dv3study-41e121b5@example.com' expected_email,
u.raw_app_meta_data=jsonb_build_object('provider','email','providers',jsonb_build_array('email'),'astra_staging_study_room_fixture',jsonb_build_object('version',1,'runId','dv3study-41e121b5','label','student')) expected_app_marker,
(select encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') from public.profiles t where t.id=u.id) profile_hash,
(select encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') from public.forum_profile_settings t where t.user_id=u.id) forum_profile_hash,
(select encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') from public.user_roles t where t.user_id=u.id) role_hash,
(select encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') from private.internal_test_accounts t where t.user_id=u.id) registry_hash,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',t.id,'provider',t.provider,'providerMatchesId',t.provider_id=u.id::text,'subjectMatches',t.identity_data->>'sub'=u.id::text,'emailMatches',t.identity_data->>'email'=u.email,'createdAt',t.created_at,'updatedAt',t.updated_at)) from auth.identities t where t.user_id=u.id) identities,
(select encode(sha256(convert_to(to_jsonb(t)::text,'UTF8')),'hex') from public.debate_v3_events t where t.id='de-4fb85fc5fbf904733a7a265eb9c7c08e') event_row_hash,
(select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('action',t.action,'bucket',t.bucket,'count',t.count)) from public.debate_v3_rate_limits t where t.actor_id=u.id::text) rate_rows,
(select count(*) from auth.audit_log_entries t where position(u.id::text in t.payload::text)>0) retained_auth_audit_count
from auth.users u where u.id='7ce735e9-228f-4cc6-a7e3-16e1081f7618'::uuid;
